messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, playable browser game inspired by Roblox-style animal feeding/simulator games, using a polished meadow setting and food-tossing gameplay.

## Requirements
- Complete the build without asking clarifying questions.
- Make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them.
- Save and inspect screenshot evidence for visual verification.

## Decisions
- Use a self-contained HTML/CSS/JavaScript implementation.
- Present the game as “Snack Safari,” with a bright illustrated field-guide aesthetic.
- Assume a single-player desktop/mobile experience rather than a multiplayer Roblox backend.
- Use a 5-delivery mission loop, ranks, coins, streaks, snack selection, and happy-animal reactions.

## Objective
- Build a complete, playable browser game inspired by Roblox-style animal feeding/simulator games, with a polished meadow setting and food-tossing gameplay.

## Requirements
- Complete the build without asking clarifying questions.
- Make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them.
- Save and inspect screenshot evidence for visual verification.
- Use a self-contained HTML/CSS/JavaScript implementation.
- Assume a single-player desktop/mobile experience.
- Include 5-delivery missions, ranks, coins, streaks, snack selection, and happy-animal reactions.
- Exercise feeding, wrong-snack, mission, modal, keyboard, and mobile interactions.

## Decisions
- Present the game as “Snack Safari,” with a bright illustrated field-guide aesthetic.
- Use canvas for the scenic world and DOM elements for UI/HUD.
- Use no external asset files or image downloads; visuals are canvas drawing and emoji.
- Use plain HTML/CSS/JavaScript with `index.html`, `styles.css`, and `game.js`.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created the main game shell in `index.html`.
- Created the responsive visual system in `styles.css`.
- Implemented canvas rendering, animals, meadow scene, snacks, projectile physics, scoring, missions, ranks, streaks, sound controls, reactions, and field-guide modal in `game.js`.
- Fixed canvas coordinates and projectile/aim rendering for the updated animal positions.
- Implemented pointer/touch tossing and keyboard snack selection.
- Added desktop and mobile layouts.
- Confirmed the app implementation is complete enough for runtime verification.
- Attempted to launch the app on `http://localhost:3002`.

### Active
- (none)

### Blocked
- Browser verification is blocked because the runtime server exited and did not accept connections.
- Screenshot capture remains blocked because `http://localhost:3002` returned `ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED`.
- Feeding, wrong-snack, mission, modal, keyboard, and mobile interactions remain pending visual verification.

## Next Move
1. Launch `start.sh` with `PORT=3002` or a reliable fallback static server that remains running.
2. Open `http://localhost:3002` and verify it responds.
3. Capture a small JPEG screenshot and inspect the latest image.
4. Exercise feeding, wrong-snack, mission, modal, keyboard, and mobile interactions.
5. Fix any rendering or gameplay defects found during verification.

## Relevant Files
- `/home/runner/work/Throwfood/Throwfood/index.html`: Main game markup and modal structure.
- `/home/runner/work/Throwfood/Throwfood/styles.css`: Desktop/mobile visual design and HUD styling.
- `/home/runner/work/Throwfood/Throwfood/game.js`: Canvas scene, animal preferences, throwing physics, scoring, missions, and audio.
- `/home/runner/work/Throwfood/Throwfood/start.sh`: Development server launcher.
- `/home/runner/work/Throwfood/Throwfood/capture.sh`: Screenshot capture launcher.

## Important Context
- Animal preferences are stored in `animals[].food`; favorites can rotate after all three animals are fed.
- The 5-delivery mission resets when complete and awards 80 coins.
- Every 5 deliveries awards a rank increase and 35 bonus coins.
- Capture commands require `CAPTURE_URL=http://localhost:3002` and `CAPTURE_DIR=/home/runner/work/Throwfood/Throwfood`.
- The capture helper reported `CAPTURE_URL`/`CAPTURE_DIR` unset when first run.
- The server launch attempts ended with no output or with `ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED`; no screenshot was generated.
